scenes.title: Act 1 — One Tap Order
scenes.speaker: Liam
scenes.text: [playful] One tap on your phone, and a whole neighborhood springs into motion.

scenes.title: Act 2 — Four-Step Choreography
scenes.speaker: Liam
scenes.text: [warmly] Your order wakes the corner bakery, pairs with the nearest bike rider, and picks the quickest sunlit route.

scenes.title: Act 3 — Live Sync Tracker
scenes.speaker: Liam
scenes.text: [excited] Watch the bakery board and your pocket screen stay perfectly in step — right up to the doorbell.

scenes.title: Act 4 — Warm Morning Finale
scenes.speaker: Liam
scenes.text: [warmly] That is how thoughtful choreography turns one simple tap into a warm morning at your door.
